topography.project_purpose: Liquid Restaking. Structurally: 79 project-authored contract(s) across 7 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 6 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, ownableupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
